panels.title: Revision: acids, salts and chemical tests
points: Flame tests: Li⁺ red, Na⁺ yellow, K⁺ lilac, Ca²⁺ orange-red, Cu²⁺ blue-green
NaOH: Cu²⁺ blue, Fe²⁺ green, Fe³⁺ brown precipitates
NH₄⁺: warm with NaOH, gas turns damp red litmus blue
H₂: squeaky pop; O₂: relights glowing splint

panels.title: Describe how to make pure, dry copper(II) sulfate crystals from copper(II) oxide. [6 marks]
points: Warm dilute sulfuric acid in a beaker
Add copper(II) oxide until in excess (no more dissolves)
Heat the filtrate to evaporate some water
